user.title: Connect to Trade Republic
user.description: Choose your authentication method. Using the Home Assistant App is recommended to keep sessions alive automatically.

data.session_token: Session Token (sessionToken UUID from Local Storage)

addon.title: Trade Republic App
addon.description: Connect via Trade Republic Home Assistant App to keep sessions alive automatically.

addon_confirm.title: Discovered Trade Republic App
addon_confirm.description: Trade Republic Home Assistant App was discovered at {host}. Do you want to connect to it?

addon_login.title: Login via Trade Republic App
addon_login.description: Enter your credentials. The Trade Republic App will solve bot challenges in the background.

addon_2fa.title: 2FA Confirmation
addon_2fa.description: Confirm the login in your Trade Republic smartphone app, or enter the SMS code below if received. If confirmed in the app, simply click Submit without entering a code.

data.code: SMS Code (Optional if confirmed in smartphone app)

mfa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
mfa.description: Please enter the verification code sent to your phone or app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Trade Republic
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired. If you are using the Trade Republic Home Assistant App, ensure you are logged in via the App Web UI and click Submit. Otherwise, enter a fresh sessionToken or your PIN.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the server or App
error.invalid_pin: PIN must be between 4 and 6 digits (numbers only)
error.invalid_phone: Please provide a valid phone number
error.addon_no_session: No active session found in the Trade Republic App. Please open the App Web UI first and log in.

init.title: Trade Republic Options
init.description: Adjust update interval, interest rate, or trigger an instant re-authentication directly within Home Assistant.

reauth_required.title: Trade Republic Re-authentication Required
reauth_required.description: Your Trade Republic session has expired. Please re-authenticate your integration.
